_comment: First early-game ladder (2026-10-10): only fully-proven stages. P0 zone, P3 forage-eat, P6 pots (crucible food chain), plus P1 flint-tools with a live knapping surface. Exit oracles read WORLD STATE (never mission claims). Run: python3 scripts/r2-progression.py builds/ladder-earlygame.json --world polis-survival-5

stages.desc: settlement zone exists (runner creates it if absent)
stone tools: mine loose flint, craft the knapping surface, knap 12 flakes
forage-eat: a bot finds a wild fruiting bush, picks and eats to satiety
pots: clayform -> pit-kiln fire -> firepit cook -> eat (one background chain)
